document.title: IEC60601-1 Safety Test Report
document.file_reference: ETX202303-07-078-02 PT9L 安规报告-正式

regulations.description: Standard for CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES for MAINS TRANSIENT VOLTAGE of 4 kV
Standard for actuator of SUPPLY MAINS switch

tests.requirement: Connection and anchorage at both ends of a flexible cord to a HAND-HELD or foot-operated control device of ME EQUIPMENT at both ends of cable to control device complied with 8.11.3 when breaking free or shorting between conductors could result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1
Requirement applied to other HAND-HELD parts when disturbance or breaking of one or more of connections could result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1
Mechanical protection of wiring

Internal cables and wiring adequately protected against contact with a moving part or from friction at sharp corners and edges where damage to insulation could result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1
tests.result_remark: Adequately protected that cannot result in hazardous situation. See Appended RM Results

tests.requirement: Wiring, cord forms, or components are not likely to be damaged during assembly or during opening or closing of ACCESS COVERS where such damage could result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1
Guiding rollers of insulated conductors prevent bending of movable insulated conductors around a radius of less than five times the outer diameter of the lead concerned in NORMAL USE
Insulating sleeve that can only be removed by breaking or cutting, or secured at both ends, is used on internal wiring when needed
Sheath of a flexible cord not used as a MEANS OF PROTECTION inside ME EQUIPMENT when it is subject to mechanical or thermal stresses beyond its RATED characteristics
Insulated conductors subject to temperatures > 70°C in NORMAL USE provided with insulation of heat-resistant material when compliance is likely to be impaired due to deterioration of insulation
MAINS PARTS, components and layout
ME EQUIPMENT provided with means of electrically isolating its circuits from SUPPLY MAINS simultaneously on all poles

PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT connected to a poly-phase SUPPLY MAINS equipped with a device not interrupting neutral conductor, provided local installation conditions prevent voltage on neutral conductor from exceeding limits in 8.4.2 c)

PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT provided with means to isolate its circuits electrically from the SUPPLY MAINS are capable of being locked in the off position if reconnection would result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION or any OPERATOR including SERVICE PERSONNEL is unable to view the means of isolation from their intended position
Means of isolation incorporated in ME EQUIPMENT, or if external, described in technical description
A SUPPLY MAINS switch used to comply with 8.11.1 a) complies with CREEPAGE and CLEARANCES in IEC 61058-1 for a MAINS TRANSIENT VOLTAGE of 4 kV
A SUPPLY MAINS switch not incorporated in a POWER SUPPLY CORD or external flexible lead
Actuator of a SUPPLY MAINS switch used to comply with 8.11.1 a) complies with IEC 60447

A suitable plug device such as an APPLIANCE COUPLER or a flexible cord with a MAINS PLUG used in non-PERMANENTLY INSTALLED ME EQUIPMENT with no SUPPLY MAINS switch to isolate it from SUPPLY MAINS considered to comply with 8.11.1 a)
A fuse or a semiconductor device not used as an isolating means
ME EQUIPMENT not provided with a device causing disconnection of ME EQUIPMENT from SUPPLY MAINS by producing a short circuit resulting in operation of an overcurrent protection device

Parts within ENCLOSURE of ME EQUIPMENT with a circuit > 42.4 V peak a.c. or 60 V d.c. that cannot be disconnected from its supply by an external switch or a plug device accessible at all times is protected against touch even after opening ENCLOSURE by an additional covering
d.c. limit of 60 V applied to d.c. with no more than 10% peak-to-peak ripple
42.4 V peak limit applied when ripple exceeded 10% peak-to-peak limit

semantic_fragments.content: 8.10.5a: Internal cables and wiring adequately protected against contact with a moving part or from friction at sharp corners and edges where damage to insulation could result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1. Result: Adequately protected that cannot result in hazardous situation. See Appended RM Results. Verdict: P (Pass).

Clause 8.11 and all sub-clauses (8.11.1 a through i) are marked N/A because the product (PT9L) is not permanently installed ME equipment and does not use SUPPLY MAINS connection requiring isolation means as described. The product uses a plug device (APPLIANCE COUPLER or flexible cord with MAINS PLUG) as isolation means.
